steps.text: Complete the other 49 base-game achievements. The 19 DLC achievements are required for Steam's overall 100%, but not for this achievement's unlock condition.

achievements.summary: Earn every other base-game achievement; the two DLC packs are not required for The Chronicler itself.

steps.text: Continue the main story to the start of Main Quest 7, A Chance Encounter; the achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.summary: Reach Main Quest 7, A Chance Encounter.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 12, Headwind; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 12, Headwind.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 22, Buried Memories; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 22, Buried Memories.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 26, The Crystals' Curse; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 26, The Crystals' Curse.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 36, Fire and Ice; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 36, Fire and Ice.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 38, Capital Punishment; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 38, Capital Punishment.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 43, Into the Darkness; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 43, Into the Darkness.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 51, Fire in the Sky; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 51, Fire in the Sky.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 61, Through the Maelstrom; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 61, Through the Maelstrom.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 64, The Last King; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 64, The Last King.

steps.text: Continue the main story through Main Quest 66, Streets of Madness; the achievement unlocks automatically at its end.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 66, Streets of Madness.

steps.text: Complete Main Quest 68, Of Gods and Men; the achievement unlocks automatically for finishing the story.

achievements.summary: Finish Main Quest 68, Of Gods and Men.

achievements.description: Punish 10 enemies (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, knock a normal enemy down with a four-hit combo or an Eikonic ability, then use a basic attack while it is grounded. Repeat until 10 Punishes have registered; the same enemy can count more than once.

achievements.summary: Punish grounded enemies 10 times outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.displayName: You're Not the Boss of Me

steps.text: Make a manual save before Midnight Raven at the end of Main Quest 9, Fanning Embers, equip the Ring of Timely Evasion if desired, and defeat it without taking a hit.
If you miss that attempt, finish the story and replay The Greatwood from the Arete Stone with your stronger endgame build; Midnight Raven still counts in Stage Replay.

achievements.summary: Defeat an eligible boss without taking damage.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, after Limit Break unlocks in Main Quest 23, activate Semi-Prime with at least one full Limit Break segment and land the killing blow on 20 enemies. Progress is cumulative across battles.

achievements.summary: Defeat 20 enemies while semi-primed outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Deal an enemy 50,000 damage while it is staggered (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue and while fully primed as Ifrit).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue and while controlling Clive rather than fully primed Ifrit, stagger a durable enemy, raise the multiplier quickly, then unload your strongest available attacks before it recovers.

achievements.summary: Deal 50,000 total damage during one stagger outside the Hall of Virtue and not while fully primed as Ifrit.

achievements.description: Land 15 Shift Strikes or Shift Shots combined (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, equip Phoenix, use Phoenix Shift to close on an enemy, then immediately follow with melee for Shift Strike or magic for Shift Shot. Land 15 combined hits.

achievements.summary: Land 15 Shift Strikes or Shift Shots outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Execute and land 2 Heatwave Counters in a single battle (excluding those in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, buy and equip Phoenix's Heatwave after Main Quest 7. Activate Heatwave just before a ranged projectile hits so 'Heatwave Counter' appears, then repeat before the battle ends.

achievements.summary: Land two Heatwave Counters in one battle outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 enemies in the air after using Deadly Embrace (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, weaken a small enemy, jump, pull it into the air with Garuda's Deadly Embrace, and land the killing blow before either of you lands. Repeat for five enemies.

achievements.summary: Defeat five airborne enemies after Deadly Embrace outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Land Gouge, Wicked Wheel, and Rook's Gambit in midair before landing (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Master one of the three Garuda abilities so it can be assigned to another Eikon, then equip all three at once.
Outside the Hall of Virtue, jump first against a large target and use Wicked Wheel, Rook's Gambit, and Gouge before touching the ground; at least one hit from each must connect.

achievements.summary: Outside the Hall of Virtue, land Gouge, Wicked Wheel, and Rook's Gambit during one jump.

achievements.description: Discharge 50 Blind Justice lightning balls (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, equip Ramuh, aim and release Blind Justice balls, then damage the marked enemies to discharge them. Repeat until 50 balls have discharged.

achievements.summary: Discharge 50 Blind Justice lightning balls outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Lure an enemy into striking a Lightning Rod 3 times before it dissipates (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, cast Ramuh's Lightning Rod near a large charging enemy and stand behind it. Reposition until that same enemy has triggered the rod three times in one cast.

achievements.summary: Outside the Hall of Virtue, make one enemy strike the same Lightning Rod three times before it expires.

achievements.description: Use Titanic Block to fend off 10 enemy attacks (excluding battles in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, equip Titan and hold Titanic Block as attacks arrive. Any successful block counts; a Precision Block is not required, and progress carries across battles.

achievements.summary: Block 10 enemy attacks with Titanic Block outside the Hall of Virtue.

achievements.description: Land the third punch of a Titanic Counter twice in a single battle (excluding those in the Hall of Virtue).

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, time Titanic Block just before an attack for a Precision Block, then press attack through all three counter punches. Land the third punch twice before the encounter ends.

achievements.summary: Complete Titanic Counter III twice in one battle outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, charge Bahamut's Wings of Light to at least level 2 and release Megaflare. The 100-hit total is cumulative across battles.

achievements.summary: Land 100 hits with level-2-or-higher Megaflare outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, fully upgrade Wings of Light, activate it against a familiar enemy, and execute three Precision Dodges during the same charge.

achievements.summary: Perform three Precision Dodges during one Megaflare charge outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, use Shiva's Cold Snap at the last moment before an attack. A perfect dodge freezes the area with Permafrost; repeat 10 times, even on the same enemy.

achievements.summary: Inflict Permafrost 10 times with perfect Cold Snap dodges outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, gather three weak enemies, lower their health, freeze them with Permafrost or Frostbite, then use Diamond Dust to kill all three together.

achievements.summary: Defeat at least three frozen enemies simultaneously outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, charge Odin's Zantetsuken gauge with Arm of Darkness attacks and Odin abilities, then release it at level 2 or higher. Repeat five times across battles.

achievements.summary: Land level-2-or-higher Zantetsuken five times outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, activate Arm of Darkness and parry by attacking as an enemy strike lands. Repeat until three Steel Counters register in that encounter; Semi-Prime's faster melee attacks can help.

achievements.summary: Execute three Steel Counters in one battle outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: Choose one Eikon skill tree and spend AP to fully upgrade its feat and every Eikon-specific ability. Phoenix is the cheapest at 13,425 AP; central basic combat skills do not count.

achievements.summary: Master every ability and feat belonging to one Eikon.

steps.text: Accumulate 118,400 AP and fully upgrade the eight base-game Eikon trees plus the central combat tree; Leviathan and Ultima are handled separately by A Most Worthy Vessel.
After two playthroughs, farm the Hyenas east of Ravenwit Walls in Vidargraes on Final Fantasy mode if AP is still short; the group yields about 1,120 AP per 90-second cycle.

achievements.summary: Max out the eight base-game Eikon trees and the central combat tree.

achievements.description: Upgrade consumable potency and inventory slots to their maximum.

achievements.summary: Collect the 22 curiosities displayed on the Wall of Memories in Clive's room.

achievements.description: Craft or upgrade 5 pieces of gear.

steps.text: Use Blackthorne's forge in the Hideaway to craft or reinforce five weapons, belts, or vambraces. Normal gear progression supplies enough opportunities.

achievements.summary: Craft or upgrade five pieces of gear at Blackthorne's forge.

steps.text: Do not sell Ragnarok, Orichalcum, Darksteel, or Primitive Battlehorn before crafting the sword.

Complete Blacksmith's Blues I-IV for the Design Draft and Ragnarok. Get 3 Orichalcum from Atlas, Gorgimera, and Behemoth King; 2 Darksteel from Thanatos and Prince of Death; and 1 Primitive Battlehorn from Gobermouch. Craft Gotterdammerung at Blackthorne's forge before New Game+.

achievements.summary: Craft Gotterdammerung from Ragnarok, 3 Orichalcum, 2 Darksteel, and 1 Primitive Battlehorn.

steps.text: After the Reading Table unlocks in Main Quest 27, return between main and side quests and open any 10 of the letters that arrive.

achievements.summary: Open 10 letters at the Reading Table in Clive's room.

steps.text: Complete main and side quests to collect Active Time Lore, then speak to Harpocrates in the Hideaway between quests so he records it. Continue until his knowledge reaches level 5.

achievements.summary: Raise Harpocrates to knowledge level 5.

achievements.description: Obtain all available items from your patrons.

steps.text: Complete main quests, side quests, and Hunt Board marks until total Renown reaches 2,850, then visit Desiree at the Patron's Whisper in the second Hideaway and claim every available item.

achievements.summary: Earn 2,850 Renown and claim every Patron's Whisper reward.

steps.text: Stand beside Torgal outside combat, face him, and use the interaction prompt to pet him. Repeat five times.

achievements.summary: Pet Torgal five times.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, command Torgal with Sic immediately after the fourth hit of Clive's basic combo; the orange aura confirms a Precision Sic. Repeat five times. The Ring of Timely Assistance can trigger them automatically.

achievements.summary: Land five Precision Sics outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: After Main Quest 31, Release, complete The White-Winged Wonder at Martha's Rest to unlock Ambrosia, then summon and mount the chocobo.

achievements.summary: Unlock Ambrosia and ride her once.

achievements.description: Visit all areas on the world and local maps.

steps.text: Finish every main quest and side quest while entering each newly opened region. Those quest routes visit all 68 required areas; use post-story free-roam to clean up any unrevealed map name.

achievements.summary: Visit all 68 named world-map and local-map areas.

steps.text: After the Tub & Crown opens in the second Hideaway, buy drinks from Maeve until total spending reaches 36,000 gil. The 10,000-gil round for the whole bar is the fastest repeat purchase.

achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 36,000 gil at the Tub & Crown.

steps.text: Finish the story once, create a clear save, then start New Game+ in Final Fantasy mode from that save and complete the full main story again. Gear, level, inventory, and abilities carry over.

achievements.summary: Complete New Game+ on Final Fantasy mode.

steps.text: Clear the linear Sagespire dungeon, defeat Omega, then return to Charon in the Hideaway to finish the DLC quest.

achievements.summary: Complete Echoes of the Fallen and return to Charon.

steps.text: On Final Fantasy mode, reach Back to Their Origin and complete Phoenix, Heal Thyself, Where There's a Will, and Priceless. Speak to Charon in the Hideaway and finish the opening scene to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Start Echoes of the Fallen after meeting its late-game prerequisites.

steps.text: Continue the DLC through Port Isolde and both search areas, head north to the dead-end Fallen door in The Dim, defeat the final group, and enter the Sagespire.

achievements.summary: Follow the Echoes of the Fallen objectives until you enter the Sagespire.

steps.text: Play Echoes of the Fallen during the New Game+ Final Fantasy-mode run and defeat its final boss, Omega. During Omega's last stand, use Limit Break and every available high-damage ability before the arena damage overwhelms you.

achievements.summary: Defeat Omega while the current playthrough is on Final Fantasy mode.

collectibles.location: The Sagespire, after the first door
collectibles.method: After the next enemy group, open the chest on the left before the following room.
collectibles.name: Escapement Bit

collectibles.location: The Sagespire, after Sigma and the lift
collectibles.method: Pass the rooms with enemies emerging from tubes; open the chest on the right before the stairs.
collectibles.name: Nourishment Bit

collectibles.method: Defeat Omicron; the bit is an automatic reward.
collectibles.name: Bombardment Bit

collectibles.location: The Sagespire, circular area after Omicron
collectibles.method: Defeat the Assault Unit OGR and open the chest immediately right of the exit door.
collectibles.name: Disengagement Bit

collectibles.location: The Sagespire, after Angra Mainyu and the lift
collectibles.method: Defeat the next enemy group and open the chest directly left of the following door.
collectibles.name: Assailment Bit

collectibles.method: Defeat Asterios; the bit is an automatic reward.
collectibles.name: Revivement Bit

achievements.summary: Collect all six Fallen Bits in the Sagespire.

steps.text: Do not sell Fallen Enforcer Reforged, Flawless Nodule, Flawless Tissue, or Flawless Humours before crafting the Final Fantasy-mode recipe.
After completing Echoes of the Fallen, take the boss materials to Blackthorne and craft Omega Weapon or its Reforged version immediately.

achievements.summary: Craft Omega Weapon or Omega Weapon Reforged at Blackthorne's forge.

steps.text: On the Final Fantasy-mode run, reach Back to Their Origin and complete Where There's a Will and Priceless, then read the new letter in Clive's study and accept The Rising Tide.

achievements.summary: Accept The Rising Tide quest from Clive's study.

steps.text: Continue the DLC's main objective; the achievement unlocks automatically on arrival in Mysidia.

achievements.summary: Follow The Rising Tide story until Clive arrives in Mysidia.

steps.text: Continue The Rising Tide story through the first battle using Leviathan's power; the achievement unlocks automatically afterward.

achievements.summary: Complete the battle that unlocks Leviathan's abilities.

steps.text: Continue the DLC story and defeat the Timekeeper; the achievement unlocks automatically after the battle.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Timekeeper during The Rising Tide story.

steps.text: Continue the DLC story, defeat Leviathan, and watch the following scenes; the achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.summary: Defeat Leviathan and finish The Rising Tide story scenes.

steps.text: Play The Rising Tide during the New Game+ Final Fantasy-mode run. Equip the Ring of Timely Evasion if desired, preserve heals through the phase checkpoints, break the phase-three shield quickly with Spitflare, Wildfire, and Brimstone, and defeat Leviathan.

achievements.summary: Defeat Leviathan while playing on Final Fantasy mode.

steps.text: Outside the Hall of Virtue, activate Leviathan's Serpent's Cry and repeatedly use Tidal Torrent against groups or large targets. Its multi-hit spread counts quickly, and progress is cumulative.

achievements.summary: Land 300 Tidal attacks outside the Hall of Virtue.

steps.text: During the Perykos battle, weaken three summoned enemies and group them together. Refill the Tidal Gauge, press the prompt again while its line is inside the highlighted circle, then kill all three with Tidal Torrent or Tidal Stream before unlimited ammunition expires.
If missed, repeat the setup against a weak group in Kairos Gate; merely damaging three enemies does not satisfy the hidden condition.

achievements.summary: Defeat three enemies with Tidal attacks during one Quick Refill unlimited-ammo window.

steps.text: After the DLC's main quest is complete, return to the Hideaway and interact with the Arete Stone opposite the shop to receive Ultima's Eikon.

achievements.summary: Claim Ultima's Eikon after finishing The Rising Tide story.

steps.text: Obtain both Eikons, then spend 32,500 AP to unlock and fully upgrade every Leviathan and Ultima ability. If needed, use the Vidargraes Hyena AP farm described for Masterclass.

achievements.summary: Master every Leviathan and Ultima ability.

steps.text: Complete the six Mysidian side quests that become available while progressing the DLC story before Leviathan.
After defeating Leviathan, complete any four of the five newly available Mysidian side quests to reach 10 total.

achievements.summary: Complete any 10 of the 11 Mysidian side quests.

steps.text: Find the Chronolith by Languor Falls in northern Mysidia and clear its timed waves. Use Serpent's Cry and Tidal Torrent from range to stagger the final Behemoth, then unload Limit Break and abilities while avoiding its comets.

achievements.summary: Complete the Trial by Water Chronolith in northern Mysidia.

steps.text: After The Rising Tide story, enter Kairos Gate from an Arete Stone. Choose the free Timely Evasion, Focus, and Assistance boons; prioritize Eikonic Ability Potency, then Defense, Boon Potency, and HP.
Clear all 20 rounds without dying. Use wide attacks on early waves, Leviathan at range against minibosses, and save strong temporary boons for rounds 15-20; death restarts the run from round 1.

achievements.summary: Clear all 20 consecutive rounds of Kairos Gate.
